newsitem.title: USA: Community Care Services buys Metropolitan.
newsitem.headline: Community Care Services buys Metropolitan.

text.p: Community Care Services Inc said Tuesday it acquired all shares of the privately-held Metropolitan Respiratory Services Inc, a provider of respiratory therapy and equipment.
As a result of the acquisition, which was made for about $9.0 million in cash, notes and Community Care common stock, the company's current annual revenue run rate is about $22 million.
Based in the Bronx, Metropolitan had 1996 annual revenues of about $11 million, Community Care said.
Metropolitan will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary of Community Care Services.
